description: Provincial health card numbers. Ontario: 10 digits, Luhn, grouped 4-3-3 or not at all; a version code after it is kept. British Columbia: 10 digits starting with 9, mod 11 check digit over digits 2 to 9, grouped 4-3-3 or not at all. Quebec: four letters, as one word or spelled out, then 8 digits (birth year, month or month plus 50, day, two more), grouped 4-4 or not at all; the letters are found too. Digits may be spoken as digit words in English or French. Each case lists the exact substrings a redactor must find, in order. Every number is made up.
